zh: 把上周积累的客户素材整体过一遍:先给重点客户各出一份画像速览,再按活跃度和成交情况分个层,最后给排在末尾的那批安排回访时间
en: review last week's account materials: brief each key account, tier them by activity and deal size, then book call-backs for the bottom group

zh: 最近明显感觉有些客户不吭声了:先把长时间没有互动的圈出来,查一下他们当时是因为什么走掉的,再从里面挑出还值得救的排上联系动作
en: find accounts that went quiet, look into why they left, and get the ones worth saving back on the contact schedule

zh: 这周的门店经营盘点要交:出一份本周汇总、把各店目标完成进度对比一下、销售的成交和跟进也拉个名次出来
en: prepare the weekly store review: a roll-up, each store's progress to target, and a rep ranking by deals and touches

zh: 最近客户提价格的越来越多:先把这段时间的异议归归类,再看标准说法有没有覆盖到,没覆盖的那些给出改进方向
en: group recent objections, check whether the standard replies cover them, and suggest how the wording should change where they don't

zh: 这周的通话质量要盘一下:按标准把会话原文过一遍、统计每个人的话术使用情况、命中率最低的那几位安排一轮集中辅导
en: review this week's call quality against the checklist, measure wording usage per rep, and coach the weakest few

zh: 对手最近动作挺多:把他们新的促销和价格变化整理一下、和我们自己的政策逐条比一比、再把他们的主打说法拆开给一份应答口径
en: collect the rivals' recent promotions and price moves, compare them with our policy line by line, and break down their pitch into replies for our team

zh: 报价这块得防风险:抽一批单子看看有没有越权、把明显低于底线的挑出来、再和现在执行的政策核对一遍
en: audit quotations for approvals beyond authority, flag prices clearly below the floor, and check them against the policy in force

zh: 知识库该更新了:看看客户常问却查不到的内容有哪些、把重复的条目挑出来合并、再把售后高频问题整理成问答草稿
en: update the internal wiki: find the questions asked but missing, merge duplicated entries, and draft Q and A for frequent after-sales asks

zh: 新人这周要带起来:先看他话术使用的薄弱点、据此排一份两周辅导安排、再出几道对练题给他练
en: onboard the new hire: find where their wording is weakest, lay out a two-week coaching plan, and write practice questions

zh: 库存和交付要盯紧:在售车型的库存对一遍、订单排期也核一遍、可能延期的单独列出来放进本周的汇总里
en: watch stock and delivery: reconcile what is on hand, check the order schedule, and list likely slips into this week's roll-up

zh: 线索分配得调:按门店产能和销售活跃度重新分一遍、看看最近活动的到店转化效果、再生成一份本周客户走访安排
en: rebalance leads across stores by capacity and activity, measure the last campaign's walk-in conversion, and draft this week's visit itinerary

zh: 月度经营复盘要写:各阶段客户流转和流失算一下、门店目标完成情况比一比、客户分层的变化也看一下
en: draft the monthly review: stage-by-stage flow and drop-off, each store against target, and how the account tiers shifted

zh: 这个月要抓复购:按成交金额把客户分个层、给两三个月没联系的排上回访、快过生日的先准备一段问候
en: push repeat business: split accounts by deal size, line up call-backs for those untouched for months, and prepare birthday greetings

zh: 话术质量专项:整体使用情况统计一下、长期没人用的那些给改进意见、再据此出一份辅导安排
en: a wording quality push: count overall usage, suggest improvements for unused wording, and turn that into a coaching plan

zh: 客户满意度这块:挑几段近期对话压成要点、把这一阵的异议集中汇总、再做一次客户流失原因归纳
en: look at satisfaction: condense recent conversations, pool the objections raised lately, and summarise why accounts were lost

zh: 门店管理这周排期:按客流预测把下周班次排出来、客户走访也排上、顺便把过期和快到期的跟进任务提醒一下
en: plan the store week: build next week's shifts from the traffic forecast, fit in customer visits, and remind about overdue and due-soon follow-ups

zh: 政策变动要同步:新价格政策跟知识库里的旧版本比一遍、把需要更新的条目列出来、涉及报价的部分再校验一次
en: roll out the policy change: diff the new pricing rules against the old entry, list what needs updating, and re-check anything affecting quotes

zh: 竞品专项复盘:他们最近动作出一份摘要、主打说法拆一份、和我们政策逐条比一比,最后合进月度复盘结论里
en: competitor deep dive: a digest of their recent moves, a breakdown of their pitch, a comparison with our policy, all folded into the monthly review

zh: 客户资产整个盘一遍:画像、分层、风险预警三件事一起做,给我一份总览
en: take stock of the whole customer base: briefs, tiering and at-risk alerts as one overview

zh: 周会材料准备:最近对话按诉求类型归一下类看占比、质检结果拉出来、话术使用情况也统计一下
en: prepare the weekly pack: conversations by intent, the quality-check findings, and wording usage stats

zh: 售后压力有点大:高频问题先整理成问答草稿、查一下哪些内容库里缺、再把对话里的敏感承诺排查一遍
en: after-sales is overloaded: draft Q and A for frequent asks, find which ones have no entry, and sweep conversations for risky promises

zh: 报价与折扣专项审计:审批权限核对、政策符合性校验、异常低价排查三件事一起做
en: audit quotes and discounts together: approval authority, policy compliance, and abnormally low prices

zh: 培训体系补一补:出几道对练题、给新人排辅导计划、把话术使用的短板统计出来
en: beef up training: practice questions, a coaching plan for new hires, and stats on where wording usage falls short

zh: 客户运营做成闭环:先分层、按层次排走访、走访完再排回访
en: close the loop on accounts: tier them, schedule visits by tier, then line up call-backs afterwards

zh: 经营预警一揽子:门店目标缺口提示、逾期任务提醒、各阶段转化也看一下
en: one pass on business alerts: stores behind target, overdue follow-ups, and how each stage converts

zh: 知识运营三件事:重复条目合并、售后问答草稿、政策变动的同步清单
en: three things for the wiki: merge duplicates, draft after-sales Q and A, and list what the policy change affects

zh: 从线索到成交整条链复盘:线索分配的效果、活动的到店转化、各阶段流转效率
en: review the path from lead to close: how allocation performed, campaign walk-in conversion, and stage-to-stage efficiency

zh: 对话质量专项:敏感表述排查、诉求归类统计、再把关键几段压成要点
en: a push on conversation quality: scan for risky wording, tally intents, and condense the key exchanges

zh: 客户关怀活动安排:近期过生日的准备问候、老客户排回访、重点客户安排上门走访
en: plan a care round: birthday greetings, call-backs for long-standing accounts, and on-site visits for key ones

zh: 月度全套材料:月度经营复盘、本周汇总、销售名次一起给我
en: the full monthly pack: the monthly review, this week's roll-up, and the rep standings

zh: 把本季度新进的客户拉出来,看看每个人的负责销售和当前阶段,再把最近的活动记录一起调出来
en: pull the accounts added this quarter, show the owner and stage for each, and bring up their latest activity history

zh: 挑几家重点客户看看最近的沟通记录,把重要的那几次补一条备注,再给他们打个重点客户的标记
en: go through the recent history of a few key accounts, add notes for the important exchanges, and flag them so they stand out

zh: 按名字找几个客户,核对他们的公司和对接人,再看看他们手上还有哪些在谈的项目
en: look up a few accounts by name, check company and contact details, and see which deals are still open

zh: 把本季在谈的项目金额过一遍,金额填错的直接改掉,再算一下各阶段转化
en: review the amounts on this quarter's open deals, correct the ones entered wrong, and work out stage conversion

zh: 客户抱怨挺多:把还没关掉的工单列出来,挑几条看看详情和处理时限,已经处理完的直接改成已解决
en: complaints are piling up: list open cases, check a few in detail with their deadlines, and close the finished ones

zh: 想搞清楚大家到底在问什么:按关键词搜工单、挑命中最高的看详情、再去内部知识库找有没有对应的说明
en: work out what people keep asking: search cases by keyword, open the top matches, and check the internal wiki for an explanation

zh: 财务对账:应收的单子列出来、回款记录核对一下、退款申请也一起拉一遍
en: reconcile the books: list what customers owe, check incoming amounts, and bring up money-back requests

zh: 有几张单子客户说算错了:把明细和税点调出来、核对一下付款记录、再写封邮件把差异解释清楚
en: customers say a few bills are wrong: open the itemised detail and tax, check the payment record, and mail an explanation of the difference

zh: 下周要见几位客户:先看看日历上已经有什么安排、找几个大家都有空的时段、把见面先约上
en: there are customer meetings next week: check what is already booked, find windows that suit everyone, and put them in

zh: 原定的会要挪时间:找个不冲突的时段、把安排改掉、再给参会人发封说明邮件
en: the planned meeting needs moving: find a clash-free slot, change the booking, and let attendees know by mail

zh: 邮箱里太乱了:按关键词把和价格有关的往来找出来、看看最近几封讲了什么、再统一回一封说明
en: the mailbox is a mess: find the threads about pricing by keyword, read the latest messages, and send one reply covering everyone

zh: 给团队出一份数据表:先建一个带表头的表格、把整理好的数据写进去、再导出成文件发出去
en: make a data table for the team: create it with headers, write the prepared rows in, and export it as a file to share

zh: 表格数据要接上:先读一下原来那块数据、把新增的接在后面、再导出新版本
en: continue the existing table: read the current range, append the new rows, and export a fresh copy

zh: 看经营数据:把上个月的指标查出来、看看有哪些现成看板可用、再拉一次漏斗数据
en: look at business numbers: query last month's metrics, see which dashboards exist, and pull the funnel numbers

zh: 仓库要盘一遍:商品清单列出来、看每个仓库的在库量、再把在途的到货时间也列上
en: take stock of the warehouse: list products, show quantities per location, and add estimated arrival for goods in transit

zh: 这批货要催:查一下发货状态和预计到达、把可能延误的挑出来、再给相关同事建个跟进任务
en: chase this shipment: check dispatch status and expected arrival, flag likely delays, and create a follow-up task for the colleague

zh: 帮我盯一下手上的事:列出还没做完的按到期时间排一下、做完的那些直接关掉、再把结果同步到群里
en: watch my work queue: list what is still open by due date, close the finished ones, and post the outcome to the channel

zh: 知识库整一整:先按类别看看文章数量、搜几个关键词看命中情况、再把重要的那几篇正文读出来
en: tidy the wiki: list categories and counts, search a few keywords to see hits, and read the body of the important pages

zh: 人员信息核对:列出各部门的人和负责人、看看团队排班可用性、再给负责人建一条确认任务
en: check people records: list staff by department and manager, see team shift availability, and create a confirmation task for the manager

zh: 文档处理:把这份文档的内容读出来、导出成 PDF、再把结果通知到群里
en: handle a document: read its text, export it as PDF, and notify the channel with the result

zh: 客户档案补齐:看看联系方式是否完整、核对最近几次沟通、缺失的信息补一条记录进去
en: fill in account records: check contact details, look at recent interactions, and add a note for whatever is missing

zh: 项目推进会要准备:各阶段在谈金额列出来、算一下转化情况、再看几个重点项目最近的沟通
en: prepare the pipeline meeting: list open deal amounts by stage, work out conversion, and review recent activity on the key deals

zh: 回款提醒:把快到期的应收找出来、核对是否已经回款、给还没付的客户写封提醒邮件
en: chase payments: find bills falling due, check whether the money arrived, and mail a reminder to those who have not paid

zh: 客户到访安排:看看下周日历排了什么、找个共同空档、再建一条接待任务
en: arrange a customer visit: check next week's diary, find a common window, and create a task to receive them

zh: 竞品情报追踪:在邮箱里搜竞品关键词、把相关往来打开看看、把要点记成一条沟通记录
en: track competitor intel: search the mailbox for rival keywords, open the relevant threads, and log the key points as an activity

zh: 看板梳理:列出现有看板、把最近指标查一遍、再拉一次漏斗核对口径
en: review reporting: list available dashboards, query recent metrics, and pull the funnel again to check the definitions

zh: 库房与交付:商品和在库量查一下、核对发货计划、可能延期的通知到群里
en: stock and delivery: check products and quantities, review dispatch plans, and post likely delays to the channel

zh: 任务管理:给自己建一条今天的待办、把清单列出来、做完的直接关闭
en: task management: add a to-do for today, list my queue, and close what is done

zh: 合同归档:把合同文档读出来、导出 PDF、再把文件发给对接同事
en: file the contract: read the document, export it as PDF, and mail the file to the colleague

zh: 培训安排:列出参训人员和他们的排班情况、找一段大家都有空的时间
en: arrange training: list the trainees and their shift availability, and find a window that works for everyone

zh: 从系统里拉出本月新增的客户,结合我们的会话记录看看谁提到过分期付款,再给这些人各建一条跟进待办
en: pull this month's new accounts, check the conversation records for anyone mentioning instalments, and create a follow-up task for each of them

zh: 有几单一直没解决:把没关掉的工单列出来、对照会话原文看看客户到底怎么说的、再统计一下我们话术的覆盖情况
en: some cases are still open: list them, check the conversation records for what the customer actually asked, and measure our wording coverage

zh: 这周的周报要写:先查一下在谈项目的金额、再看各阶段转化的数据、最后把周报生成出来
en: draft this week's report: query open deal amounts, review stage conversion numbers, then produce the weekly roll-up

zh: 经营例会材料:把上个月的经营指标查出来、出一份门店业绩预警、再把各阶段转化算一遍
en: for the business meeting: query last month's metrics, raise store performance alerts, and compute stage conversion

zh: 投诉处理要统一口径:把最近的工单找出来、看看我们的异议汇总、再据此出几道对练题给团队练
en: standardise complaint handling: pull recent cases, review our objection summary, and turn it into practice questions for the team

zh: 价格政策落实情况:拉一批开出的单子、核对是否符合现行政策、再找找明显异常的折扣
en: check how pricing rules are applied: pull a batch of issued bills, verify them against the current policy, and find clearly abnormal discounts

zh: 竞品情报汇总:在邮箱里搜竞品相关的往来、结合我们自己的竞品动态摘要、给出一份对比结论
en: pull competitor intel together: search the mailbox for rival threads, combine with our own digest of their moves, and write a comparison

zh: 新人带教要看数据:把他手上客户的情况拉出来、评估他的话术使用水平、再排一份辅导计划
en: onboard the new hire with data: pull their account list, assess their wording usage, and lay out a coaching plan

zh: 库存和交付对一下:看在库数量、核对订单排期、把可能延期的写进本周汇总
en: reconcile stock and delivery: check quantities on hand, verify the order schedule, and note likely slips in this week's roll-up

zh: 客户拜访准备:把档案和最近沟通调出来、生成一份走访安排、再把见面约进日历
en: prepare a customer visit: pull the profile and recent interactions, draft an itinerary, and book the meeting in the calendar

zh: 知识缺口排查:按关键词搜工单、去内部知识库找有没有对应说明、把缺口记成补充建议
en: find knowledge gaps: search cases by keyword, check whether the wiki explains them, and record the gaps as suggestions

zh: 数据交付:把指标查出来、导出成表格文件、再发邮件给同事
en: deliver data: query the metrics, export them as a sheet, and mail the file to the colleague

zh: 排班安排:看团队排班的可用情况、生成下周门店排班、再给班次负责人建一条任务
en: plan the rota: check team shift availability, build next week's store rota, and create a task for the shift lead

zh: 流失与工单一起看:找出有未结工单的客户、对照我们的流失风险名单、给出挽回建议
en: look at churn and cases together: find accounts with open cases, cross-check our at-risk list, and suggest how to win them back

zh: 客户分层做细一点:把在谈金额一起纳入、重新分一次层、给最上面那批排回访
en: refine the tiering: fold in open deal amounts, re-tier the accounts, and schedule call-backs for the top group

zh: 质检整改:先把会话按标准检一遍、把检出的问题和相关工单核对、输出一份整改清单
en: act on quality findings: run the conversation check, cross-check the findings against the related cases, and produce a fix list

zh: 活动效果复盘:从工单和邮件里找活动相关的反馈、结合我们自己的活动复盘数据、给一个结论
en: review the campaign: gather feedback from cases and mail, combine with our own campaign numbers, and draw a conclusion

zh: 报价与合同核对:把发票明细调出来、读一下合同文档确认条款、再走一次审批符合性检查
en: check quote and contract: pull the invoice detail, read the contract document for the terms, and run the approval compliance check

zh: 交付催办:看发货状态、核对交付排期、给客户发封延迟说明邮件
en: chase delivery: check dispatch status, verify the delivery schedule, and mail the customer an explanation of the delay

zh: 知识沉淀:把工单里反复出现的问题整理成问答草稿、再做一次重复条目检查
en: build knowledge: draft Q and A from the recurring issues in cases, then check for duplicated entries

zh: 客户关怀排期:把客户联系方式拉出来、找出近期过生日的、生成问候并建一条提醒任务
en: plan customer care: pull contact details, find upcoming birthdays, prepare a greeting, and create a reminder task

zh: 销售排名和项目一起看:把在谈金额拉出来、出一份销售名次、再算各阶段转化
en: see ranking and pipeline together: pull open deal amounts, produce the rep standings, and compute stage conversion

zh: 活动线索分配:把活动来的客户挑出来、按门店产能分下去、再跟踪一次活动效果
en: allocate campaign leads: pick out the accounts that came from the campaign, distribute them by store capacity, and track the campaign result

zh: 库存和政策一起核:看品种与在库量、校验价格政策、把异常项写进月度复盘
en: check stock and policy together: review products and quantities, validate the pricing policy, and note exceptions in the monthly review

zh: 沟通记录归档:把邮箱里的往来打开、记一条活动备注、把关键结论写进会话摘要
en: file the correspondence: open the mail threads, log an activity note, and put the key conclusions into the conversation summary

zh: 培训考核:统计话术覆盖情况、出几道对练题、把结果写进表格
en: training and assessment: measure wording coverage, write practice questions, and put the results into the sheet

zh: 投诉升级处理:取工单详情、把状态改成处理中、把处理结果同步到群里
en: escalate a complaint: open the case detail, move its status along, and post the outcome to the channel

zh: 客户资产盘点:把客户和在谈项目一起列出来、结合我们的分层规则、输出一份盘点结论
en: take stock of accounts: list customers and open deals, apply our tiering rules, and write up the conclusion

zh: 交付和排班别冲突:看在途发货、核对交付排期、排班时把到货日避开
en: keep delivery and shifts apart: check goods in transit, verify the delivery schedule, and plan shifts around arrival dates

zh: 复盘材料:拉漏斗数据、出月度复盘、再写一份本周汇总
en: review materials: pull funnel numbers, write the monthly review, and produce this week's roll-up

zh: 异议知识化:从工单里把异议找出来、汇总成清单、补充进知识库建议里
en: turn objections into knowledge: gather them from cases, summarise the list, and add it to the wiki suggestions

zh: 走访安排:先找几个空档、排一份客户走访计划、再建提醒任务
en: plan visits: find free windows, draft a customer visit plan, and create reminder tasks

zh: 价格与发票核对:调发票明细核对金额、校验政策符合性、把异常发邮件给财务
en: check pricing against bills: pull invoice detail, validate policy compliance, and mail the exceptions to finance

zh: 生日营销:把近期过生日的客户筛出来、准备问候动作、再复盘一下这类活动的效果
en: birthday marketing: filter upcoming birthdays, prepare the greeting, and review how this kind of campaign performed

zh: 知识问答质量:检索一下看命中情况、读一篇确认内容是否过期、把缺口写进补充建议
en: check answer quality: search the wiki, read one page to see whether it is stale, and note gaps as suggestions

zh: 工单时限风险:列出工单看有没有超时风险、取详情确认、把紧急的直接改状态并同步
en: case deadline risk: list cases for breach risk, open the detail to confirm, and push the urgent ones forward

zh: 销售培训闭环:出对练题、排辅导计划、再把短板写进培训安排
en: close the training loop: write practice questions, plan coaching, and fold the weak spots into the training plan

zh: 客户走访计划:先分层、按层次排走访、再把见面约进日历
en: visit plan: tier the accounts, schedule visits by tier, and book them in the calendar

zh: 延误预警:查在途到货、核对排期、把可能延期的通知到内部群
en: delay warning: check goods in transit, verify the schedule, and post likely delays to the internal channel

zh: 全域经营复盘:拉经营指标、出月度复盘、再把销售排名算出来
en: full business review: query the metrics, write the monthly review, and compute the rep standings
